opening.argument: The title and description identify beginner iPhone repair as the subject, and the footage shows a person working with a microscope and tool at a repair workstation. The accompanying material offers training and consultation and discloses a commission on purchases through its links. Those details fit an educational repair demonstration with ordinary service and product recommendations. The available evidence describes no investment solicitation, credential collection, or required payment scheme. Brief footage of people carrying a coffin does not establish a different purpose or a scam mechanism.
